cronSchedule.description: Cron expression (5 fields) or a @-macro such as @daily.

description: Imports Trivy / Kyverno CRD data from this cluster into KubePosture. Deploy to EACH cluster that has Trivy Operator and/or Kyverno installed. Creates a CronJob that reads CRDs from the local K8s API, filters them for relevance, uploads one compressed bundle per kind to the KubePosture bundle endpoints and commits the import atomically.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description:
Maximum run time for the import job. A cycle is ~10 requests and
normally finishes in seconds. Must stay <= the central's
IMPORT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (1200) so a slow-but-alive import is never
raced by a second one.
activeDeadlineSeconds.title: activeDeadlineSeconds

cleanupFailedJobsOnSuccess.description:
After a successful run, delete previously failed Jobs owned by the
same CronJob (main or trigger, whichever just succeeded). For the
trigger that includes idle ticks that found nothing pending — a
successful pending check proves the earlier failure is gone.
Transient failures (connection resets, etc.) that later resolve on
their own would otherwise sit in the Job history and keep tripping
failed-job alerts. Grants `delete` on Jobs in the release namespace
only (templates/role.yaml). failedJobsHistoryLimit still applies as a
cap for the case where cleanup itself can't run.
cleanupFailedJobsOnSuccess.title: cleanupFailedJobsOnSuccess

clusterName.description: Cluster name as registered in KubePosture (e.g. cluster-name-1, cluster-name-2). Required.
clusterName.title: clusterName

coverage.description:
Scan-coverage check (record + alert, never aborts the import): the
ratio (matched / expected) below which the importer prints a WARNING
and the central logs `import.coverage_low`. Kyverno coverage is always
informational.
coverage.title: coverage

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full release-qualified resource name.
fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

httpTimeoutSeconds.description:
Per-request HTTP timeout (seconds) for calls to the KubePosture API.
A bundle upload is one request; bump this if uploads of SBOM-heavy
clusters time out through a slow LB/ingress.
httpTimeoutSeconds.title: httpTimeoutSeconds

image.description: Image containing the import script + kubernetes Python client
image.title: image

initialRun.description:
Run the import once on install/upgrade, then follow the schedule.
Set to false to only run on the schedule.
initialRun.title: initialRun

logLevel.description:
Importer log verbosity: info | debug (debug lists unmatched digests
and every deployed digest with its source — useful once, noisy always).
logLevel.title: logLevel

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

relevanceFilter.description:
Relevance filter: drop scan reports for images that are not
currently running (Trivy keeps a report for every historical
ReplicaSet) and for workloads no longer in the snapshot. The central
would skip or hide those anyway; shipping them is pure cost. Set to
false as an escape hatch while investigating a digest mismatch
(coverage ratio unexpectedly low) — no central change needed.
relevanceFilter.title: relevanceFilter

serviceAccount.description: Service account: needs read access to Trivy and Kyverno CRDs
serviceAccount.title: serviceAccount

tmp.description:
Scratch space for building the bundles (one uncompressed pass of
the snapshot, ~20 MB for a mid-size cluster, then the gzipped
bundles). Mounted at /tmp (readOnlyRootFilesystem is on).
tmp.title: tmp

token.description:
KubePosture API token — provide either a plaintext value or a secret reference.
If secretRef.name is set it takes precedence over value.
token.title: token

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the import pods (passed through verbatim).
tolerations.title: tolerations

trigger.description:
On-demand reimport trigger (pull pattern).
A second CronJob ticks every minute and only runs the full import when
an admin has clicked "Re-import" in KubePosture. Most ticks just hit
/api/v1/imports/pending/ and exit immediately. Disable to fall back to
the 6-hour cadence above.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description:
Same deadline as the main job: idle ticks complete in seconds, but
when a real import fires it runs the same code path and needs the
same budget.
activeDeadlineSeconds.title: activeDeadlineSeconds

trigger.title: trigger

uploadDeadlineSeconds.description:
Wall-clock budget for uploads + commit inside one run. Past it the
importer stops retrying and aborts the import server-side, so a clean
abort always lands before Kubernetes SIGKILLs the pod at
activeDeadlineSeconds. Must be < activeDeadlineSeconds.
uploadDeadlineSeconds.title: uploadDeadlineSeconds
